properties.displayName: Deny public IP addresses on virtual machines and scale sets
properties.description: No compute resource in this platform may have a public IP. Interactive access is through Azure Bastion; outbound traffic is through the hub firewall; inbound traffic is through Front Door. A public IP on a VM or node pool bypasses all three of those controls at once, and is almost always created as a temporary debugging convenience that is never removed.

metadata.rationale: See docs/architecture/03-network-topology.md. This is the policy that makes 'no public IPs' a property of the subscription rather than a property of the Terraform.

metadata.description: Start at Audit. Promote to Deny once the compliance report is clean.
